summary: Targeted retest (frontend only) of the iteration_5 HIGH bug fix in SQL Arena plus the sr-only h1 accessibility fix. All 3 requested checks PASS. (1) Opening challenge-c02/c05/c12 loads a runnable starter query 'SELECT * FROM Payments LIMIT 10' in [data-testid=sql-editor] (no prose); clicking btn-run-sql returns SUCCESS with 10 rows and zero sql-error banners. (2) c01 with the correct solution SELECT * FROM Payments WHERE Status = 'Failed' submits and submit-result shows 'CORRECT - well done' with 8 rows returned. (3) /about, /experience, /projects, /skills, /resume, /contact each expose exactly one <h1>. No regression re-run of Phase 6/7/8 per instruction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_6 verified only the SQL Arena starter-query fix (openChallenge resets sql to 'SELECT * FROM Payments LIMIT 10'), the correct-submission path for c01, and single-h1 accessibility on the six content pages. Earlier full regression lives in iteration_5 (backend 11/11, frontend 12/13). No open issues remain.
rca_of_the_issue: Prior bug: openChallenge injected challenge prose into the editor and the arena SQL guard rejects non-SELECT/comment text, making the starter query un-runnable. Fix verified: openChallenge now unconditionally sets sql to a plain SELECT; challenge text stays in the right-hand detail panel.
